task: Which of these clips are in Telugu? Translate those into English
summary: Telugu clips identified: clip_2.wav and clip_4.wav. English translations produced: (1) clip_2.wav → “the market will be closed tomorrow because of a holiday”; (2) clip_4.wav → “the train arrives at six am”. Transcription language detection was used to decide Telugu.
assumptions: Auto language detection in transcribe_audio correctly identified Telugu for clip_2 and clip_4.

plan.plan: 1) For each clip (clip_1.wav..clip_5.wav), call transcribe_audio with language='auto' to detect spoken language and capture a transcript path; this lets us determine which clips are Telugu. 2) For those clips identified as Telugu (script/language code indicates Telugu), call translate_text from the transcript_path into English; then run verify_translation for each translation. 3) Return: (a) list of Telugu clips by file name, and (b) English translation outputs as deliverable files.
assumptions: Language auto-detection in transcribe_audio is reliable enough to distinguish Telugu from other supported Indic languages for these short clips.
Each translated transcript will be short enough to keep translation cost within the budget.
